sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOUSEHOLD_1_133' AND s.store_id = 'CA_2' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('year', c.date)::date ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of sales (y) for the specified item and store, aggregated by year (ds), using the M5 dataset.
